# Example Bikes

> Bike shop that sells, fits and repairs city, road and electric bikes.

Format: https://llmstxt.org. Below is the text of the home page (https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo), mirrored at https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/llm.md, followed by links to a Markdown copy of each other page.

- Reading preference: Example Bikes would rather AI tools use the Markdown files than the HTML pages. This is a preference only; robots.txt blocks nothing.
- Updated: 2026-01-31

## Bikes we sell

- City bikes for the daily commute.
- Road bikes for longer rides.
- Electric bikes for hills and heavy loads.

## Services

- [Bike fitting](https://example.com/services/bike-fitting.md): a one-hour fitting that sets a bike up around its rider.

## Brands we stock

Brand One, Brand Two, Brand Three.

- [About](https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/about.md): We have sold and repaired bikes in Sample Town since 2014.
- [Bike fitting](https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/services/bike-fitting.md): A one-hour fitting that sets a bike up around its rider.

## Files

- [/llms.txt](https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/llms.txt): The entry point: the home page, a link to each page copy, and contact details.
- [/llm.md](https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/llm.md): An alias of /llms.txt for tools that look for this name.
- [/llms-full.txt](https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/llms-full.txt): The index and every page copy, joined into a single file.

# About

Source: https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/about

> We have sold and repaired bikes in Sample Town since 2014.

## How we work

- Every bike gets a test ride before you buy it.
- Repairs have fixed prices, agreed before we start.

## Shops

### Example Bikes Centre

Sales, workshop and fitting studio, 2014 to now.

### Example Bikes Riverside

Sales and quick repairs, 2020 to now.

---

# Bike fitting

Source: https://luisfilipeoliveira.github.io/agent-ready-site/demo/services/bike-fitting

> A one-hour fitting that sets a bike up around its rider.

## Problem

Riders on a badly set-up bike get sore knees and backs, and stop riding after a few weeks.

## What we do

We measure the rider, adjust saddle, bars and cleats, and check the result on a short ride.

## Outcome

Nine in ten riders we fit come back for the yearly check.

---
